sources.title: 二简字 (Erjian) table
sources.author: Andrew West
sources.note: Entry 2.2:003 has 瓣 as ⿱艹半; entry 2.2:007 has 避 as ⿺辶比. The draft’s own explanation of the table says 廴 was merged into 辶, and the entries follow that. Read 2026-11-01. A form the page leaves as ？ is given in IDS here only when the 2000 BabelStone Erjian 2 font draws its component; the examples drawn from ？ entries are ⿰口𠂇 (嚼), ⿱艹⿰氵？ as it stands (磅礡), ⿱？巴 (霸), ⿰？了 (聊), ⿱？双 (霜) and ⿱于心 (愚). 2.2:008 簿 is left out: the page spells its bamboo head 𥫗 and its glyph draws a 竹 head with the four-stroke 𥫗 inside, which the composer cannot draw. Unicode 18.0 encodes ⿰忄井 as U+327F1, the second-stage form of 警 and 儆 ([IRG WS2021 record 01312](https://hc.jsecs.org/irg/ws2021/app/?id=01312)); that example keeps its character. ⿱亠公 is also the IDS of U+2CEA4, a different character read xuán and a semantic variant of 玄 ([IRG WS2024 record 00095](https://hc.jsecs.org/irg/ws2024/app/index.php?id=00095)), so the 衮 form stays unencoded. The table-1 examples are already encoded characters, and their descriptions are BabelStone’s. The 繁體字 of each standard comes from [Unihan 18.0.0 kTraditionalVariant](https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/ucd/Unihan.zip): 厩→廄 (U+5EC4), 衮→袞 (U+889E), 弹→彈 (U+5F48) and 数→數 (U+6578); the other twelve standards have no variant, so their 繁體字 is the character itself. Read 2026-11-09.

sources.title: Proposal to Add a Character to the UTR #45
sources.author: John H. Jenkins, Richard Cook, Ken Lunde
sources.note: Proposes the 招財進寶 ligature as a U-source character and gives its CDL: 宀 at the top, a 辶 wrapping the square from the 宀’s band, and 王, 尔, 隹, 貝 and 招 inside. It cites Chinese New Year decorations as the attestations.

sources.title: U-source ideographs (UTR #45)
sources.note: UTC-00949 records the 招財進寶 ligature as ⿱宀⿺辶⿱⿰王尔⿲隹貝招, status NoAction. The record nests the 宀 above the 辶; the proposal’s glyph puts the 辶 around it, and the example follows the glyph (⿺辶⿱宀⿱⿰王尔⿲隹貝招). The drawing approximates the hand-set glyph; the export’s 宀 has longer side strokes than the reference, so a box-for-box placement would merge them with 王 and 尔. The reference glyph is [docs/images/utc-00949-reference.png](https://github.com/mkpoli/ids-input/blob/main/docs/images/utc-00949-reference.png).

sources.title: 揮春上的合體字　你看懂幾多？ (新春篇)
sources.author: UHK 港生活

The article describes the shared 口 of 唯吾知足, the shared 子 of 學好孔孟, and the borrowed strokes of 黃金萬兩 and 吉祥如意. Its 唯吾知足 cross and its 萬 with the 両 bottom are the arrangements the examples draw. Read 2026-10-29.

sources.title: 幽霊文字
sources.author: WDIC Creators club

sources.title: 幽霊文字
sources.author: Wikipedia contributors
sources.note: Lists the historical twelve unresolved JIS characters: 墸, 壥, 妛, 彁, 挧, 暃, 椦, 槞, 蟐, 袮, 閠 and 駲. Unresolved JIS provenance can coexist with historical same-shape attestations; proposed miscopy origins remain hypotheses. JIS X 0208:1997, Annex 7, and the old dictionaries are cited indirectly through this article. Read 2026-10-31.

sources.title: A list of kokuji (国字)
sources.note: The 157 characters the list gives as kokuji, with kana readings, romaji and English meanings, read 2026-10-31. The examples use each character's first kana reading. sources.author: @Eonway_Ying

The 建 is quoted inside the poster’s own overlay rather than read from the photograph. The post gives no sequence, so ⿺廴占 is put into IDS notation from the form shown.

sources.title: 第二次汉字简化方案（草案）
sources.author: 中国文字改革委员会
sources.note: Table 1 lists 建→迠, 1 of the 172 first-table simplifications the draft would have put into print.

sources.title: IRG Working Set 2024 character 01372
sources.note: Records ⿺廴占 under radical 廴 with stroke counts SC=5, FS=2 and TS=8, as similar to 建 (U+5EFA); the evidence was accepted at IRG 63 and IRG 65. Evidence from 林安玲, L. F. Cheng, Ken Lunde, Andrew West and YUAN Zhiyu includes an air letter from 廈門, a 1958 Yunnan museum commemorative plaque, 汉字正字小字汇（初稿）1966 and 春慶寺建之. A comment cites Roar Bökset’s Long Story of Short Forms on ⿺廴占 beside ⿺廴介. Read 2026-11-01.

sources.title: Long Story of Short Forms: Simplified Chinese characters from A to Z
sources.author: Roar Bökset
sources.note: ISBN 9789188763228, Kungl. Vitterhets Historie och Antikvitets Akademien. Entry 01372 quotes its account of 建: a correspondent from 安康, Shaanxi told the Script Reform Committee in 1960 that locals wrote 建 as ⿺廴占 or ⿺廴介, and that ⿺廴占 spread while ⿺廴介 stopped. The quotations are read through the IRG record; the book itself was not consulted.

sources.title: cjkvi-ids ids.txt
sources.author: Kawabata Taichi and the CJKVI Database
sources.note: Read 2026-11-01. Describes 迠 (U+8FE0) as ⿺辶占, beside 建 as ⿺廴聿; lists 菓, 苐, 証 and 講 without the 草 forms. Licensed GPL v2 or later, so its rows inform this note and are not copied into the data.

sources.title: Old Korean syllable blocks in a Buddhist manuscript
sources.author: @sebansios
sources.note: Read 2026-11-01. The post asks how the vertical pair of two syllable blocks in Buddhist texts would be encoded. Its photograph shows a manuscript of Han text with a two-syllable block above each glossed line, both marked 二合: ᄋ + ᆞ over ㄹ + ㅏ, and ㄷ + ᆞ over 륵. The poster reads them @ra and d@ruk. The first block marks both syllables, the double-dot 방점 above and the single dot below; the second marks only its lower syllable. The letters are that transcription; the manuscript is not identified, and the vowel these examples write ᆞ is the poster’s @, which the photograph marks with a dot of its own.

sources.title: JurchenSources.txt, Unicode 18.0

sources.title: Editorial Jurchen descriptions

sources.title: 简化字的简化方法
sources.note: Read 2026-11-07. Under 仿日文假名 it gives 卫（衛） and quotes 易熙吾 and 陳光垚 for the katakana origin, then records the other explanations in circulation: that 卫 keeps the middle of 韋 (《商務漢字精解字典》, 2012), and the folk etymologies of 倪匡 (a banner on the ground) and 流沙河 (the initial P of protection).

sources.title: ⿲意情意, read 의정의, in 韓国漢字字典
sources.author: @JUMANJIKYO (竹澤雅文)
sources.note: A photograph of the 心部 entry printed 33, with 1127 and KC01341 below the glyph, in 檀国大学校東洋学研究院『韓国漢字字典』. The entry reads *의정의; its gloss reads [國字] ‘情’과 ‘意’를 결합하여 만든 글자. 마음[心]이 움직일 때에는 정(情)과 의(意)에 선후가 따로 없는 것을 나타낸다고 한다, and 《厚齋集》22 is cited under it. The post calls the form the Korean gukja with the most strokes, with a question mark. The book was not read; the page is known only from this photograph.

sources.title: 不想上班那就別上 set as four characters
sources.author: @egasmb (Egas Moniz Bandeira)
sources.note: Gives the four characters of a photographed sign as ⿱⿰不目心 ⿲上丿王 ⿰𭃂尤 ⿰另上, for the sentence 不想上班那就別上, each character carrying two syllables. Quotes @Y_Wenli’s [post of 2026-02-02](https://x.com/Y_Wenli/status/2018441903633572033), whose photograph shows the sign. The sequences are the poster’s reading of that photograph; the sign states no reading.

sources.title: 旧日本海軍における位相文字の研究
sources.author: 鈴木健心
sources.note: The abstract of a talk at 日本漢字学会 第八回研究大会 (2025-12-07, A会場, 14:00), p. 4 of the 発表要旨集: it calls the 位相文字 of 漢字的構成 used in the Imperial Japanese Navy 海軍漢字 and studies their use, notation and formation, gathering examples from Navy documents, old dictionaries, 水軍 material and industrial material, with 艏, ⿰舟右, ⿰舟カ and ⿱仿皿 among the forms. The 予稿集 itself was distributed at the venue; no copy was found online, and only this abstract was read.

sources.title: 漢字「艏」と日本海軍の「海軍漢字」
sources.author: 海鳥水兵
sources.note: The author’s write-up of the same conference talk. It defines 海軍漢字 as the 略字, 俗字 and 造字 (位相文字) of the Imperial Japanese Navy, names 艏 (みよし), 艉 (とも), ⿰舟右 (右舷), ⿰舟左 (左舷), ⿰舟カ (カッター) and ⿱仿皿 (方位盤), and counts about sixty forms, past eighty with variants. On ⿲木十木 it reports the US intelligence dictionary Japanese Military and Technical Terms, but observes that the Navy did not use the term 機関銃, so Navy use is unlikely. The page marks its images as the author’s and not for reuse, so none is copied.

sources.title: ⿲木十木 as 機関銃, likely an Army form
sources.author: @xWcvlUa1jn96009 (海鳥水兵)
sources.note: Gives ⿲木十木 as 機関銃. The post says the form was listed in a dictionary US military intelligence compiled during the war and that it stands in the poster’s own 海軍漢字表 and last year’s 漢字学会 conference proceedings, but concludes, with 一二 (@Ametsuchi_kanji), that 機関銃 is likely an Army character, not a Navy one. 一二’s note reads 注1. 「機関銃」は海軍で実際に使用された文字ではないという説が有力です.

sources.title: ⿰車ト as トラック, used by the Army too
sources.author: @xWcvlUa1jn96009 (海鳥水兵)
sources.note: Gives ⿰車ト as トラック and notes that many books present it as a character used by the Navy, as the program did. It reports that 笹原宏之 heard the Army used it, which is why the Ground Self-Defense Force also writes トラック with this character, and concludes the Army likely used it too.

sources.title: ⿰米林 as ハヤシライス
sources.author: @xWcvlUa1jn96009 (海鳥水兵)
sources.note: Gives ⿰米林 as ハヤシライス. The program presented the form as 主計科 瀬間中佐’s; the post reports an earlier document carrying the same form, also written by a 主計科 officer, and reads it as a 位相文字 used in the 主計科 within the 海軍漢字. BabelStone gives the same description to 𮇥 (U+2E1E5, G), a different character.

sources.title: ⿰甫舎 as a variant of 舗
sources.author: @mkpoli
sources.note: Replies to @hoshikira01 that the character is recorded somewhere and links [GlyphWiki’s u2ff0-u752b-u820e](https://glyphwiki.org/wiki/u2ff0-u752b-u820e), adding that Unicode has no code point for it and that the IDS ⿰甫舎 can express it. The post does not name 舗; the reading as 舗 and the variant relation are the maintainer’s, and the GlyphWiki page was not read.

sources.title: 光 beside the 冖 of 軍, on a driving-school poster
sources.author: @monkey0026
sources.note: The poster reads 車がないと輝かない, and its logo draws 光 beside the 冖 that tops 軍, with the 車 left out. The post writes the logo as ⿰光冖 and wishes IDS could write ⿰光⿱冖◌. The example spells it ⿰光㇯軍車, since ㇯軍車 is 軍 without 車; that spelling is this project’s, not the post’s.
